The '''Steel Smallsword''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword weapon]] that can be obtained from the chest on floor 20 in [[The Mines]]. It can also be purchased for {{Price|750}} from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] after reaching floor 20 in [[The Mines]].
